Notes: The whiteboard photo is cleaned up and added to the note as an image, with the text below if you want.

Notes: Up to 20 pages. If the PDF already has text it's used directly; if it's scanned, it's read like photos.

Notes: A course calendar becomes deadlines (via Import course calendar); an assignment becomes a task.

Notes: Allow access to the camera or photos to continue.

Notes: Type the content by hand or read the pages again.

Notes: Your schedule is built from your subjects.

Notes: Set the time ranges you use. Classes you already have move with their block; only those in blocks you remove are lost.

Notes: Whoever shared it may have turned it off or changed it. Ask them for a new one.

Notes: Written in Kaderno. Read only; whoever shared it can turn off the link.

Apuntes: No se pudo abrir el historial
Se borra su resumen del historial. Las materias archivadas y sus apuntes no se borran.
Notes: Its summary is removed from your history. Archived subjects and their notes aren't deleted.

Notes: Add a semester that already ended

Apuntes: Ya terminó la época de clases. Cuando tengas las notas finales, ciérralo para guardar el resumen.
Notes: Classes are over. When you have your final grades, close it to save the summary.

Apuntes: Este semestre todavía no tiene materias. Las que crees en Materias quedan en él.
Notes: This semester has no subjects yet. The ones you add in Subjects go here.

Apuntes: Las notas en curso salen de tus calificaciones. Al cerrar, confirmas la nota final de cada una.
Notes: Current grades come from your assessments. When you close it, you confirm each final grade.

Apuntes: Tus semestres, sus notas y el promedio acumulado
Notes: Your semesters, their grades and your cumulative average

Notes: Add your semester subjects and, when it ends, close it to save your grades. You can also add semesters you've already finished.

Apuntes: Las materias de este semestre quedaron archivadas con sus apuntes y archivos: búscalos con Ctrl K o restáuralas desde la Papelera.
Notes: This semester's subjects were archived with their notes and files: find them with Ctrl K or restore them from the Trash.

Apuntes: Con la fecha de fin, Kaderno te recuerda cerrarlo cuando termine.
Notes: With the end date, Kaderno reminds you to close it when it's over.

Notes: Course calendar text read from the photo: check it and tap Review.

Notes: Add exams, assignments and quizzes with their weight. You can leave the grade empty until you get it.

Notes: The remaining {remainingWeight}% isn't enough to reach {t}. The highest possible is lower.

Notes: You need an average of {toFixed} on the remaining {remainingWeight}%.
